collection.description: The best napper in the village finds a very small child already asleep in the shade: lie down too, or admit defeat.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is, in (subject.his/her) own opinion, the best napper in the village. (subject.He/She) can nap anywhere: under a tree, by the fire, once standing up. Today (subject.he/she) settles down in the shade and finds (friend), a very small child, already asleep there, flat on (friend.his/her) back with (friend.his/her) arms flung out like a starfish.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) lies down beside (friend), at a respectful distance, and closes (subject.his/her) eyes. When the grown-ups come looking, they find the two of them asleep side by side in exactly the same position, arms out, mouths open, both snoring softly. Somebody fetches a blanket for each. Nobody wakes either of them.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) studies (friend) for a while: the perfect stillness, the tiny snore, the leaf stuck to (friend.his/her) cheek that (friend.he/she) hasn't even noticed. "Well," (subject) murmurs, "you're better than me." (subject.He/She) finds another tree and naps there instead. It's a good nap. But (subject.he/she) knows, in (subject.his/her) heart, it isn't the best one in the village today.
